title: Installation Jobs: Job-Size Adder Schedule for Late Reschedule Fees
content:
**Job-size schedule for the late reschedule fee — Installation Jobs**

The late reschedule fee base of a customer reschedule on an **Installation Jobs** record is the method's late reschedule fee plus a job-size adder set by the openings on the contract the job installs.

The openings counted are read from the contract the job installs:

- for a window job, the openings on the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs;
- for a door job, the units on the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract the job installs.

## Adder schedule

| Openings (or door units) on the contract the job installs | Job-size adder (USD) |
|---|---|
| more than 20 | 50.00 |
| 11 to 20 | 25.00 |
| 10 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundaries

| Contract openings | Band | Adder |
|---|---|---|
| 21 | more than 20 | 50.00 |
| 20 | 11 to 20 | 25.00 |
| 11 | 11 to 20 | 25.00 |
| 10 | 10 or fewer | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- A window job installs a window contract of 24 openings under a method whose late reschedule fee figure is 175.00. The late reschedule fee base is 175.00 plus 50.00, that is 225.00.
- A door job installs a door contract of 2 units under a method whose late reschedule fee figure is 150.00. The base is 150.00 with nothing added.

## Points of the schedule

- The count is the contract's own openings or units, as the contract record shows them, not the units on the job.
- The window contract decides for a window job and the door contract for a door job.
